name: Business name is visible in the applications row-view grid
description:
Objective: Business name is visible in the applications row-view grid.
Preconditions: Open Data integrity with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Data integrity.
2. Business name is visible in the applications row-view grid.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The automation-owned business name must appear in the Applications row-view grid after searching for it.
